{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm that the QA orders (999999.99) are present
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Now count completed orders (status == 'completed')
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")

# Check if any QA orders are in the completed group
qa_completed = qa_orders[qa_orders['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of QA orders that are completed: {len(qa_completed)}")"}
